senses.gloss: झंकार झंकार, i. e. झम्, an imitative sound, -कार, m. Humming, Bhāg. P. 8, 8, 43.
झंकारित झंकारित, i. e. झम्-कारित (ptcple. pf. pass. of the Caus. of कृ; cf. the last), n. Humming, Bhartṛ. 1, 97.
झनज्झना झनज्झना, a reduplicated form of an imitative sound झनत् (cf. झणत्कार ?). The sound caused by the flapping of an elephant's ear, Kām. Nītis. 1, 45.
